# Oracle source correction — 2026-09-29

This correction was made before the current tested contract-team run. It corrects the expectation source chain; it is not fitted to tested output. The prior independent review remains unchanged for audit.

- `members.lock.json` pins `contract-intake` 1.0.6 at commit `7c3f436852aa258259a166f3b376243587bfe915`.
- `git -C workspace/sources/contract-intake show 7c3f436852aa258259a166f3b376243587bfe915:skills/contract-intake-gate/SKILL.md` shows S7.1: `统一社会信用代码缺失 | FLG-PARTY-ID-ABSENT`.
- R02/R03 identify buyer, seller and witness, but neither file contains `统一社会信用代码` or `注册号`. Each current gate is therefore the single value `conditional`; the missing identifiers are a concrete pending item and downstream work continues. R7 is not the reason.
- C06a/b each declare Attachments 1–3 but deliver only embedded Attachment 2. The explicit C06a→C06b comparison is client-perspective, global coverage is partial, global direction is undetermined, and Attachment 2 direction is up. A body zero-diff cannot establish whole-contract consistency.
- Current mandatory targets restore source-text facts and false-positive protections without adopting unverified legal conclusions. C04 facts (five-year non-compete, express no compensation, twelve-month probation), C05 law/forum/data text, C03 all three missing clauses, C01 false-positive prohibitions, and R02/R03 date/old-law-name/imprecise-arbitration text remain testable. Legal effect or article conclusions stay pending professional review.
- The explicit C08 draft scenario records the user's request text and `execution_validation_requested: false`; it does not invent an `unsigned` statement. Signature pending alone does not reduce its gate. Unknown/undeclared purpose remains the blocked execution-readiness scenario.

The static guard checks these rules and freezes the parsed `history` value with a SHA-256 deep-comparison digest. Contract fixture bytes are not modified.

## Second-round scope and source-binding correction

The 69 historical mandatory identities remain byte-for-byte in the parsed `history` object. They are not all asserted to have same-ID semantic equality with the current service boundary. Forty-nine candidate scope changes are recorded in the separate top-level `provenance` object, explicitly marked `normative: false`; each `scope_change` names one or more current executable coordinates, a reason, and the review source. The guard rejects this ledger if it is copied back into `normative`, points to a missing/optional target, or invents a non-historical key. The remaining unchanged historical items bind directly.

Every current `must_detect` and `must_not_flag` target now declares `required` explicitly. The only optional executable observation is C01 arithmetic consistency (`required: false`) and it carries a reason. C01 `amount-in-words-mismatch` remains a required false-positive prohibition grounded in clause 4.1; it is not interchangeable with that optional arithmetic observation.

Current evaluation uses normalized IDs only. C04 requires the three source-text facts, not the superseded legal-effect labels. C05/C07 require `professional-referral` for actual out-of-service-scope handling; a missing-pack label cannot substitute. Governing-law/forum coexistence is a source fact, not a predetermined conflict. R01/R02 require old-law-name and arbitration wording facts plus professional-review boundaries where applicable; R03 requires the 2019 date and source wording and prohibits a repeal-at-signing conclusion. This executable contract does not claim to decide natural-language entailment, legal correctness, or whole-matter acceptance.

`oracle-source-bindings.json` freezes relation metadata for every current executable target: exact case, polarity, ID, requiredness, source file/SHA, evidence IDs, literal quotes or negative-search patterns and scopes. The guard compares this frozen binding with the oracle, checks literal quotes against actual source bytes, and executes the frozen negative searches against actual source bytes. Thus an existing but irrelevant evidence ID cannot be swapped in silently. This is a mutation guard over explicitly authored source bindings. Those bindings require independent semantic review; no human professional review has been performed or is claimed. It is not an automated proof that a quote legally entails a conclusion.

R01 retains two distinct source-grounded false-positive prohibitions. The literal heading `2、组成合同的文件` identifies a procedural constituent-file list and does not by itself prove missing delivered attachments. The literal buyer line containing `XXXXXXXXXXXX` is an unfilled placeholder; the same placeholder pattern is used for seller and witness, so it must not also be classified as party-name inconsistency. Separately, the blank template has no signing time, so only the old-law-name fact and a professional-review boundary are required; no repeal-at-signing effect is pre-approved.
